entries.title: Psalms 99:1
segments:
PSALM XCIX. 
 
  Israel is required to praise God, for their hasty constitution both in   church and state, ver. 1-5.   Some instances of the happy administration of it, ver. 6-9. 
 
  V. 1. People-Such as are enemies to God and his people. Sitteth-Upon the ark.  He is present with his people. Earth-The people of the earth.  Moved-With fear and trembling.

entries.title: Psalms 99:4
segments: V. 4. Judgment-Though his dominion be absolute, and his power irresistible, yet he manages it with righteousness.  The king's strength is by a known Hebraism put for the strong, or powerful king. Equity-In all thy proceedings.

entries.title: Psalms 99:5
segments: V. 5. Foot-stool-Before the ark, which is so called,
. Holy-It is consecrated to be a pledge of God's presence.

entries.title: Psalms 99:6
segments: V. 6. Moses-Moses before the institution of the priesthood executed that office,
. That call-Who used frequently and solemnly to intercede with God on the behalf of the people.

entries.title: Psalms 99:7
segments: V. 7. Spake-To some of them: to Moses and Aaron,

entries.title: Psalms 99:8
segments: V. 8. Them-The intercessors before mentioned.  Forgavest-The people for whom they prayed, so far as not to inflict that total destruction upon them which they deserved.
